---
name: social-short-hook
description: Packaging rules for vertical social videos on Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Reels, and Shorts. Use with luna-core when the first seconds, vertical safe area, fast information density, or loopability are important.
---

# Social Short Hook

## First seconds

- Put the strongest picture, contrast, action, or core text in the first 1-2 seconds.
- Do not open on a logo, slow establishment, or empty atmosphere.
- Use only user-provided facts for place, numbers, identity, and promises.

## Rhythm

- Prefer 15-30 seconds unless the user requests otherwise.
- Change composition every 1.5-3 seconds, but let a key action finish.
- Use hard cuts as the base. Use flash, wipe, or gradient only at a section or strong beat.
- End with a visual or verbal callback to the opening when possible.

## Vertical safe area

- Keep titles and captions away from platform controls, avatars, buttons, and edges.
- Use approximately 6-12 Chinese characters per caption line, no more than two lines.
- Keep one dominant text region at a time.

## Verification

- Can the first frame be understood without context?
- Does the ending resolve or loop naturally?
- Are all important elements inside the safe area?
